{"category_edits":[{"category":"feature_construction","rationale":"Scale each input item embedding by 1 + 0.1 * min(log1p(c), 2), where c counts earlier occurrences in its visible causal prefix. Padding is excluded. This deterministic feature preserves learned embeddings, Transformer topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the modified SASRec class directly, so training and inference use identical features without additional checkpoints.","edits":[{"find":"        B, M = seq.shape
        seq_emb = self.item_emb(seq) * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5)

        pos = torch.arange(M, device=seq.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1)","replace":"        B, M = seq.shape
        seq_emb = self.item_emb(seq) * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5)

        earlier = torch.tril(
            torch.ones((M, M), dtype=torch.bool, device=seq.device), diagonal=-1
        )
        same_item = seq.unsqueeze(2).eq(seq.unsqueeze(1))
        repeat_counts = (
            same_item & earlier.unsqueeze(0) & seq.ne(0).unsqueeze(-1)
        ).sum(dim=-1).to(dtype=seq_emb.dtype)
        repeat_scale = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.log1p(repeat_counts).clamp(max=2.0)
        seq_emb = seq_emb * repeat_scale.unsqueeze(-1)

        pos = torch.arange(M, device=seq.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1)"}]}],"change_summary":"Add causal prefix-repeat input scaling consistently across all four category models and the imported inference architecture; retain all existing training settings and single-model routing."}
